article.title: Rocket Classic 2026: Model Ranks Young, Kim, Knapp Highest at Detroit
article.dek: Cameron Young leads the field in the tournament model, followed by Si Woo Kim and Jake Knapp.
article.introduction: The Rocket Classic model at Detroit Golf Club places Cameron Young at rank 1 with 574 SG Total, Si Woo Kim at rank 2 with 236 SG Total, and Jake Knapp at rank 3 with 002 SG Total. Course weights emphasize SG OTT 8%) and SG APP 3%), aligning with the top three players' combined strengths in those categories. The 147-player field opens July 30 with no weather or tee-time data available.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: Detroit Golf Club weights SG OTT at 8% and SG APP at 3%, making ball-striking the primary separator. The model ranks Cameron Young first 574 SG Total), Si Woo Kim second 236 SG Total), and Jake Knapp third 002 SG Total) among 147 entrants.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Young's 699 SG OTT and 499 SG APP align directly with the two largest course weights. Kim's 912 SG APP leads the top 20, while Knapp's 285 SG PUTT compensates for a lower 264 SG OTT.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Knapp's 002 SG Total tops the model despite a missed cut at The Open and only two tracked rounds. Young's 574 SG Total and Kim's 236 SG Total both come from four tracked rounds each.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: Young and Kim each logged four tracked rounds after The Open; Knapp logged two. The model still places all three inside the top three regardless of round count.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Kim enters at FedExCup rank 7 and Young at rank 3, both inside the top 50 bubble. Knapp sits at rank 38, still safely inside the top 50 but with less immediate pressure.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Young and Kim both skipped the Scottish Open yet rank inside the model's top two. Knapp's model rank of 3 exceeds his power rank of 3 while carrying the missed-cut and limited-reps flags.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young (model rank 1, 574 SG Total) and Si Woo Kim (model rank 2, 236 SG Total) are the two outright targets. Both carry four tracked rounds and top-10 FedExCup positioning.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: The top-10 card adds Jake Knapp (model rank 3, 002 SG Total) to Young and Kim. Knapp's putting 285 SG PUTT) supplies the model's highest single-category mark among the three.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: The same three players—Young, Kim, and Knapp—form the top-20 card. Their model ranks occupy the first three spots, and each posts at least one strokes-gained figure above 499 in a heavily weighted category.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are unavailable. Workload figures cover only recorded rounds from The Open and Scottish Open; opposite-field or non-tracked events are not included.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Tier 1 (model-supported): Cameron Young and Si Woo Kim. Tier 2 (context-supported): Jake Knapp. All three recommendations rest on model rank, SG Total, and at least one course-weighted strokes-gained category.

article.conclusion: Model tier: Cameron Young (rank 1) and Si Woo Kim (rank 2). Context tier: Jake Knapp (rank 3).

keyTakeaways.text: Cameron Young ranks first in the tournament model (1.574 SG Total) and sixth in power rank, with a 0.699 SG OTT mark that matches the course's heaviest weight.
Si Woo Kim sits second in the model (1.236 SG Total) and seventh in FedExCup standing, posting a 0.912 SG APP that exceeds the 21.3% course weight for approach play.
Jake Knapp holds the model's third spot (2.002 SG Total) and third in power rank, driven by a 1.285 SG PUTT that stands out despite only two tracked rounds post-Open.
